fruit_description: Long, narrow, dark blue-green leaves with bumpy texture
flavor_profile: Deep, earthy, slightly sweet flavor - develops sweetness in cool weather
disease_resistance: Slow to bolt in mild winters
special_characteristics: Also called Dinosaur Kale or Tuscan Kale. Most popular variety with distinctive dark blue-green, bumpy textured leaves. Slow to bolt, perfect for year-round picking in mild climates. Survives frost well and develops deep earthy sweetness in cool weather. Tender texture compared to curly varieties. Best kale for Central Texas according to gardeners.
